$comment: MACHINE half of the launcher CLI (dispatch.md is the human half). The launcher is bash, so nothing imports this file yet (rule 7 ⛑ gap: the coupling is by annotation only). `argv` is the parsed flag set, `exit` the code vocabulary, `derived` the facts the launcher computes instead of being told (ADR-094), `stderr` the verdict-line grammar a caller may match.

repo.description: the claim's repos[].name; also the pod namespace

recipe.description: path in the dispatcher's clone; mutually exclusive with run

run.description: a raw pod command (drills); mutually exclusive with recipe

work_branch.description: resume this PR branch (a fix round)

ref.description: explicit base; wins over a declared Base:

harness.description: operator override; on a gateway ride it narrows the walk to the harness's dialect

model.description: operator override on the old path; a refusal (exit 2) on a gateway ride

openrouter_secret.description: old path: a per-session key Secret name

x-meaning.0: the ride ran; or a deferral by an unreadable read / an old-path capacity gate
x-meaning.1: a refusal about the work (malformed block, goal over budget, chainless without verdict); or a gateway / router defer
x-meaning.2: a usage refusal (argv, recipe missing or unparseable, --model or interactive under the gateway, argv over the element ceiling)
x-meaning.3: a refusal about the cluster (duplicate PR or pod, WIP cap, poisoned devbox.lock, expiring key, pr-open missing, lost create race)

base.description: argv.ref, else the issue's Base:, else master

arm.description: false (NO_ARM=1 → AGENT_ARM_PR=0) for a non-protected base, a research recipe outside goal/**, an un-armed major PR's branch, an unreadable PR list, or argv.no_arm

recipe.description: argv.recipe, or its .agents/<class>.yaml sibling for a task/<class> label

anyOf.pattern: ^PREFLIGHT REFUSED: the decomposition of goal #[0-9]+ overruns its Budget\.$

goal_refusal_comment.description: the one comment on the goal; created once, patched in place
